notes: Every workflow below is exercised in dry-run or read-only mode. Nothing is merged, deployed, posted, or written outside the workflow's own temp/out dir. 'blocked' is a first-class result, never a silent skip.

workflows.description: Read-only drain of the Slack goal inbox: dedupe by message id, fail-closed on corrupt state, add_goal only on new goals.
workflows.expected: exit 0; drain completes without posting or writing goals
workflows.name: Slack goal intake (drain -> State.add_goal)

workflows.description: Run-scoreboard generator from recorded run timelines; history, not live telemetry.
workflows.expected: exit 0 and WOULD-WRITE line naming scoreboard.json/.md
workflows.name: Playbook: monitor scoreboard (dry-run)

workflows.description: Changelog from read-only git history; digest composes scoreboard + TODO + test inventory, stating absences as measured facts.
workflows.name: Playbook: ops changelog + digest (dry-run)

workflows.description: Weekly research brief from committed insights spec; absent orchestrator reports render as absent, never simulated.
workflows.name: Playbook: research brief (dry-run)

workflows.description: Dataset card from corpus metadata; required input is absent by measurement, so the honest outcome is skipped-missing-input.
workflows.expected: exit 0; reports skipped-missing-input for corpus_meta (honest absence, not failure)
workflows.name: Playbook: validation dataset card (dry-run)

workflows.description: Golden retrieval set mined from git history (commit msg -> changed files), walk-forward split, sqlite3 FTS5 BM25 baseline, leak control.
workflows.expected: exit 0; JSON with golden_set/index/baseline_on_test incl. leak_free metrics
workflows.name: Retrieval eval: commit-shaped slice

workflows.description: Same retriever scored on task-shaped queries mined from TODO.md, with answer-in-query leak control and TODO.md pruned from the index.
workflows.expected: exit 0; JSON with verdict block comparing task vs commit slices
workflows.name: Retrieval eval: task-shaped slice

workflows.description: AST-based detection of fail-open dispatches, mode-conditional escapes, and suppressed checks. --check exits 1 on un-baselined candidates.
workflows.expected: exit 0 (all baselined) or 1 (new un-judged candidates: a real finding, not a runner failure); text report names the files
workflows.name: Gate audit: verdicts nothing consumes

workflows.description: Canonical ava-factory grpo_collect: groups traces into preference pairs for GRPO. Writes to a bench temp dir only.
workflows.expected: exit 0; trace_bank.jsonl + pref_pairs.jsonl + grpo_group_stats.jsonl + MANIFEST.json exist
workflows.name: GRPO collect (canonical pipeline)

command: import json; rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('examples/goldens.jsonl') if l.strip()]; assert rows, 'empty'; [ (r['input'], r['expected']) for r in rows ]; print(f'GOLDENS_OK n={len(rows)}')
workflows.description: Structural contract check on the golden example set: every line parses as JSON with input + expected fields.
workflows.expected: GOLDENS_OK with n>0; every row has input and expected
workflows.name: Goldens contract (examples/goldens.jsonl)
